image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a man sitting in the rear-facing jump seat of a green golf cart. The man is wearing sunglasses and a black t-shirt, leaning forward with his arms resting on the silver metal roll bar. The background shows a grassy area with other parked vehicles (RVs/campers) and people, suggesting a campground or park setting rather than a golf course.

artifact_observations.location: Subject's hands and fingers gripping the roll bar
artifact_observations.reasoning: The fingers appear slightly fused and lack distinct knuckle definition. The grip on the smooth metal bar looks somewhat 'melted' or soft, lacking the precise pressure deformation expected on skin.
The vertical support poles seem to merge into the horizontal bar without clear welding joints or mounting brackets, appearing slightly ambiguous in their physical connection.

The background RVs have slightly warped geometric lines, particularly the windows and edges, which do not align perfectly with linear perspective, suggesting minor generative distortion in the background.
